manual_review_reason: The first-party route is active and free to access, but it requires a completed and signed royalty-free licensing agreement and delivery by editorial email. The legal scope of the licence, territorial and term conditions, royalty waiver, ownership and authority to license, AI-assisted-music eligibility, exact genre fit, attachment size, number of tracks and international artist eligibility require human review. Final track selection, legal approval, agreement execution and sending must remain human-controlled.
